Messages.Author: JH
Messages.Body:
Can a vampire who attempted to block a political action, but failed
and was tapped by a Faceless Night, play a Delaying Tactics, or does
the Faceless Night tap him before he has a chance to play DT? My guess
is that Faceless beats DT.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Correct. Card text: ... becomes tapped when the action is resolved
(before resolving the action).
